title: Jehu Anointed King and the House of Ahab Destroyed
description: A young prophet disciple anoints Jehu as king over Israel on the orders of the prophet Elisha. This triggers a bloody revolt in which Jehu kills Joram, king of Israel, at Naboth's vineyard in Jezreel and pursues Ahaziah, king of Judah, who dies at Megiddo. Then Jehu comes to Jezreel, where Queen Mother Jezebel is thrown from the window and trampled to death by horses. Dogs eat her body, just as the prophet Elijah had foretold. The chapter marks the fulfillment of the Lord's judgment against Ahab's house and vengeance for the blood of Naboth and the prophets that Jezebel had shed.
